name: probed_at
description: When the probe's last request to the target ended

name: execution
description: The run that probed it: the Cloud Run job's execution, so every target probed in one run shares it

name: target
description: The target's name, as UPTIME_TARGETS lists it

name: up
description: Whether it answered with the status expected, on the first try or the second

name: status
description: The HTTP status of the last answer; empty when there was none

name: expect_status
description: The status it should answer with

name: detail
description: What the last try found, such as HTTP 503, not 200, or no answer: timed out

name: attempts
description: Requests made: 1, or 2 when the first failed

name: elapsed_ms
description: How long the last try took, in milliseconds
